name: Birth of the Imperium
oracle_text:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)
I — Create a 2/2 white Astartes Warrior creature token with vigilance for each opponent you have.
II — Each opponent sacrifices a creature of their choice.
III — Draw two cards for each opponent who controls fewer creatures than you.
blocked_sentences: I — Create a 2/2 white Astartes Warrior creature token with vigilance for each opponent you have.

needs.what: a 2/2 white Astartes Warrior creature token with vigilance (e.g. astartes_warrior_2_2_w_vigilance)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: token_ids has no Astartes Warrior; the nearest are knight_2_2_w_vigilance, soldier_2_2_w_vigilance and samurai_2_2_w_vigilance (wrong creature types) and warrior_1_1_w_vigilance (wrong size). Chapters II (sacrifice over each opponent) and III (for_each_player over opponents with an if comparing creature counts, then draw 2) look expressible once the token exists.
